description: The SPW series publishes an open synthetic population for Guatemala on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Its README describes CSVs for persons with household identifiers, residence locations, activity locations and per-person activity assignments; a contact matrix and validation figures are listed separately. The source list cites DHS households, GPW demographic counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest. These agents could support an exploratory simulation of emergency-service access or population exposure to infrastructure failure in Guatemala. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this country release. A limitation is that the household and activity patterns are synthetic. They do not establish observed road demand, informal settlement locations, hazard response or facility availability. The release is labelled coarse version 0.9.0. No archive was downloaded, and its settlement coverage or validation statistics were not independently checked.
